test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure form among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1142a2bb5df06e9cefa0560373586b610c9a5cf13f41b8fe822b6ff0557439b2.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The figure with the arrow moves in clockwise direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28689b60576227d4989b973a998c8a88bf7c6a1e4b2e71dee26ac70f54f5a40c.png] 

**The alphabet at the top changes moves left to right **alternatively with the bottom.

The alphabet present in a step are one alphabet apart.

**The alphabet at the bottom moves from left to right alternatively with the top.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3af2c5813de48429b58ff1aed3baf6847ff450e32c12c1c5cfc50bec8b7557d7.png]
